description: The figure presents four pie charts comparing the distribution of answer refusal categories across four language models on FACTBENCH. The 'GPT4-o' chart shows two categories, with 'Lack of Knowledge' accounting for approximately 83.3% and 'Safety' making up 16.7%. The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart highlights 'Misinformation' as the largest category at 38.4%, followed by 'Lack of Knowledge' at 22.1%, 'Ethical Advice' at 16.3%, 'Clarification' at 14.0%, and 'Safety' as the smallest category at 9.3%. The 'Llama3.1-70B-Instruct' chart indicates 'Lack of Knowledge' as the dominant category at 75.0%, while 'Clarification' accounts for 25.0%. Finally, the 'Llama3.1-405B-Instruct' chart shows an equal distribution between 'Misinformation' and 'Lack of Knowledge,' each comprising 50.0%. These charts provide insights into the varying tendencies of language models to refuse answers based on different categories.
